an8.12:4.3: “That Blessed One must without a doubt be a perfected one, a fully awakened Buddha. For several very prominent Licchavis are praising the Buddha, his teaching … the Saṅgha in many ways.
an8.12:4.6: “Sir, I’d like to go to see the ascetic Gotama.”
an8.12:5.1: “But Sīha, you believe in the doctrine of action. Why should you go to see the ascetic Gotama, who teaches a doctrine of inaction?
an8.12:5.2: For the ascetic Gotama believes in a doctrine of inaction, he teaches inaction, and he guides his disciples in that way.”
an8.12:17.6: I believe in inaction, I teach inaction, and I guide my disciples in that way.
an8.12:18.6: I believe in action, I teach action, and I guide my disciples in that way.
an8.12:19.6: I believe in annihilationism, I teach annihilation, and I guide my disciples in that way.
an8.12:20.6: I’m disgusted, I teach disgust, and I guide my disciples in that way.
an8.12:21.6: I’m an exterminator, I teach extermination, and I guide my disciples in that way.
an8.12:22.7: I’m a mortifier, I teach mortification, and I guide my disciples in that way.
an8.12:23.6: I’m gutless, I teach gutlessness, and I guide my disciples in that way.
an8.12:24.5: I’m ambitious, I teach ambition, and I guide my disciples in that way.
